items.description: After downgrading the stock_records migration to its own down_revision then upgrade head, stock_records is recreated with all its columns, the uq_stock_records_sku_location unique constraint and the three check constraints present (schema recreated, no data-survival claim) [pytest.mark.migration]
The test session fixture refuses to run unless DATABASE_URL is a postgresql URL (no sqlite or in-memory engine)
Every /api/* route of the feature, including POST /api/stock-records success and 422 responses, responds with Content-Type application/json, never text/html
The alembic upgrade() of the stock_records migration contains only additive operations (create_table, constraints, indexes), no drop_column, drop_table or alter type
The database connection URL is read from the DATABASE_URL environment variable, with no hard-coded connection string in app/ source

FileStockForm rendered alone, submitted with a run-unique sku, location, tracking code and quantity against the real API, shows the file-stock-confirmation seam with the 'Filed' label and the submitted sku/location
FileStockForm rendered alone shows the file-stock-submit button disabled with the is-loading spinner class while the real submit is pending

Playwright e2e in client/tests/e2e/file-stock.spec.ts navigates the deployed app to /stock/new, fills field-sku (crypto.randomUUID-suffixed sku), field-location, field-tracking-code and field-quantity, clicks file-stock-submit, and the file-stock-confirmation shows the Filed outcome for that sku against the live DB
Playwright e2e in client/tests/e2e/file-stock.spec.ts shows the toast-success after submitting a valid record from /stock/new against the live DB
Re-filing an existing (sku, location) with a new quantity returns 200 with outcome 'updated' and the record quantity equal to the new value
Re-filing an existing (sku, location) returns the same record id as the first filing, so exactly one record exists for the pair
Re-filing an existing (sku, location) with a new tracking code returns the new tracking code on the same record
Filing the same SKU at two different locations returns 201 outcome 'filed' for both with two distinct record ids, each retaining its own quantity
Filing two different SKUs at the same location returns 201 for both with two distinct record ids
Re-filing an existing (sku, location) via POST /api/stock-records returns 200 with outcome 'updated' and exactly one stock_records row exists for that pair holding the new values
A direct SQL INSERT of a duplicate (sku, location) into stock_records on the branch database is rejected by uq_stock_records_sku_location
Filing the same (sku, location) twice through the upsert path leaves exactly one row in stock_records for that pair, updated in place by a single INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE
Re-filing an existing (sku, location) preserves the row's id and created_at while updated_at advances
Filing with par level, batch and serial omitted returns 201 with par_level, batch and serial all null
Filing with blank-string batch and serial returns the record with batch and serial null, not empty strings
Filing with par level omitted returns par_level null, not zero
Filing with par_level, batch and serial blank stores NULL in each of the three columns, read back directly from the branch database (parametrised per column; not '' and not 0)
A direct SQL INSERT into stock_records with a negative par_level is rejected by ck_stock_records_par_level_non_negative on the branch database, while a NULL par_level is accepted
A direct SQL INSERT into stock_records with batch set to the empty string is rejected by ck_stock_records_optional_text_not_blank on the branch database
POST /api/stock-records with a required field missing returns 422 whose errors[] names exactly that missing field (parametrised over sku, location, tracking_code, quantity)
A direct SQL INSERT into stock_records with sku NULL is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the branch database
A direct SQL INSERT into stock_records with location NULL is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the branch database
A direct SQL INSERT into stock_records with tracking_code NULL is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the branch database
A direct SQL INSERT into stock_records with quantity NULL is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the branch database
FileStockForm rendered alone, submitted with the SKU blank against the real API, renders the server's message naming sku inside the field-error-sku seam with the field--error class
FileStockForm rendered alone, submitted with required fields missing against the real API, renders the alert-error summary seam
Playwright e2e in client/tests/e2e/file-stock-missing-field.spec.ts submits /stock/new with the SKU blank and field-error-sku names the missing sku field in the live app

Playwright e2e in client/tests/e2e/file-stock-missing-field.spec.ts submits /stock/new with the tracking code blank and field-error-tracking-code names that field while the alert-error summary is visible

Playwright e2e in client/tests/e2e/file-stock-missing-field.spec.ts submits /stock/new with a missing required field and no file-stock-confirmation appears, so the record is not created, using a crypto.randomUUID-suffixed sku
Filing with a negative quantity returns 422 with an error naming the quantity field
Filing with quantity zero is accepted with 201 and stores quantity 0
Filing with the quantity field omitted returns 422 with an error naming the quantity field
Filing with the SKU omitted returns 422 with an error naming the sku field
POST /api/stock-records with quantity -1 returns 422 whose errors[] names 'quantity' and the test's own (sku, location) row count in stock_records is unchanged

The stock_records service called with its injected session and a negative quantity raises a quantity validation error without the repository upsert write ever being reached (patched repository write asserted not called)
A direct SQL INSERT of a negative quantity into stock_records on the branch database is rejected by ck_stock_records_quantity_non_negative
The upgrade() of the S2 index migration contains only additive operations (create_index), with no drop_column, drop_table or alter type

Downgrading to the S2 index migration's own down_revision then upgrade head recreates ix_stock_records_tracking_code_updated_at on (tracking_code, updated_at) as a non-unique index on stock_records (@pytest.mark.migration, schema recreated)
Rows seeded with a per-run-unique key in stock_records before the S2 index migration is downgraded to its down_revision then upgraded to head persist with their original values
GET /api/stock-records/lookup for a seeded tracking code returns 200 with Content-Type application/json, never text/html

GET /api/stock-records/lookup?code=<per-run-unique code> for a seeded record, measured in steady state against the paired Lakebase branch: issue warm-up requests first (discarded, absorbing serverless cold-connection cost), then take the median of several timed requests and assert the median responds within a threshold with headroom over the environment baseline (200ms target plus allowance for remote round-trip)
GET /api/stock-records/lookup for an unknown tracking code returns 404 with Content-Type application/json, never an HTML error page

Rendering the tracking-code lookup component and submitting the tracking code of a record filed with a per-run-unique sku/code shows lookup-result with lookup-result-sku, lookup-result-location, lookup-result-tracking-code and lookup-result-quantity matching the record, inside the card seam
Rendering the lookup component and submitting a tracking code no record has shows the lookup-not-found empty-state seam reading 'No record found for' that code, with role status and no error alert
Rendering the lookup component for a record filed with par level, batch and serial absent shows 'not tracked' in lookup-result-par-level, lookup-result-batch and lookup-result-serial, never blank

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/lookup-by-tracking-code.spec.ts) against the deployed app and live DB: file a record with a randomUUID-suffixed tracking code at /stock/new, navigate to route /, type the code into lookup-input and click lookup-submit, and lookup-result shows its SKU, location, tracking code and quantity in lookup-result-sku/-location/-tracking-code/-quantity

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/lookup-deep-link.spec.ts): opening route /?code=<randomUUID-suffixed filed code> in the real app prefills lookup-input and shows the matching lookup-result without a full page reload

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/lookup-not-found.spec.ts) against live DB: submitting a never-filed randomUUID-suffixed code U in lookup-input at route / shows lookup-not-found reading 'No record found for U' with no error page

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/lookup-not-tracked.spec.ts) against live DB: file a record via /stock/new with par level, batch and serial blank under a randomUUID-suffixed code, look it up at route /, and lookup-result-par-level, lookup-result-batch and lookup-result-serial each show 'not tracked'

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/lookup-latency.spec.ts) against live API: after filing a record with a randomUUID-suffixed code, issue a discarded warm-up lookup first, then take the median of several timed Enter presses in lookup-input at route / and assert lookup-result becomes visible within a threshold with headroom over the environment baseline (200ms target plus remote round-trip allowance), never a single cold hard 200ms bar
GET /api/stock-records responds with Content-Type application/json, never text/html, both when rows exist and when the table is empty
The integration test session fixture refuses to run unless DATABASE_URL is a postgresql URL, so the S3 list and SKU-detail reads never run against sqlite or an in-memory engine

StockTable rendered against the real EP3 API shows one stock-row-<sku>-<location> row per record with stock-cell-sku, stock-cell-location, stock-cell-tracking-code and stock-cell-quantity text, in the stock-table design-guide class
StockTable rendered against the real EP3 API with one uuid-suffixed SKU filed at two locations shows that SKU in two separate rows, one per location

Playwright e2e against the deployed app and live DB: files a crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed SKU at two locations via /stock/new, navigates to route / and sees one stock-row-<sku>-<location> per (sku, location) under stock-table, each with stock-cell-sku, stock-cell-location, stock-cell-tracking-code and stock-cell-quantity values
GET /api/skus/{sku}/stock-records responds with Content-Type application/json, never text/html, both for a SKU with records and for an unknown SKU

SkuDetail rendered for a uuid-suffixed SKU against the real EP4 API shows sku-detail-title and one sku-location-row-<location> per location with quantity and tracking code, and no rows for a distractor SKU

Playwright e2e against the live DB: with a unique SKU filed at several locations plus a distractor SKU, clicking stock-link-<sku> on route / lands on /skus/:sku where sku-detail-title shows the SKU and sku-locations lists a sku-location-row-<location> with sku-location-quantity and sku-location-tracking-code for every location of that SKU only

StockTable row for a record with NULL par_level, batch and serial renders the text 'not tracked' (not-tracked muted seam) in stock-cell-par-level, stock-cell-batch and stock-cell-serial, never blank (NFR11 clause 1)

SkuDetail sku-locations row for a record with NULL par_level, batch and serial renders 'not tracked' in sku-location-par-level, sku-location-batch and sku-location-serial, never blank (NFR11 clause 2)

Playwright e2e against the live DB: a unique SKU filed with par level, batch and serial blank shows the not-tracked text in stock-cell-par-level, stock-cell-batch and stock-cell-serial of its stock-row on route /, never blank

Playwright e2e against the live DB: opening /skus/:sku for a unique SKU filed with par level, batch and serial blank shows the not-tracked text in sku-location-par-level, sku-location-batch and sku-location-serial, never blank or a crash
Stock list rendered against a real EP3 API returning [] shows the stock-empty empty-state ('No stock recorded yet') with a File stock link to /stock/new instead of a blank table or error

Playwright e2e: drive the empty state by mocking the EP3 response with page.route matched on the API PATHNAME (new URL(url).pathname === '/api/stock-records', never a '**' glob) fulfilling with [] — no table deletion/DELETE teardown, the shared stock_records table is untouched; navigating to route / shows the stock-empty empty-state (empty-state class, 'No stock recorded yet' heading, File stock CTA to /stock/new) instead of a blank stock-table or an error

An accepted POST /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments writes exactly one stock_adjustments row carrying the submitted actor, quantity_before equal to the prior stored quantity and quantity_after equal to the new stored quantity (seeded with a per-run-unique sku, delta-scoped to that record)
The created_at of an adjustment written by an accepted POST is assigned by the database server clock, within the test's own before/after now() window, not by the client

An accepted adjustment updates the stock_records quantity and inserts its stock_adjustments entry in one transaction, so the stored quantity never changes without a matching audit row, verified directly against the branch database
POST /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments responds with Content-Type application/json for an accepted, a 422 and a 404 outcome, never text/html

In a real browser against the live DB (Playwright e2e), submitting a new quantity in the inline adjust row shows it in stock-cell-quantity before the response arrives, and page.url() is unchanged with no navigation/reload (unique crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed sku)
The inline adjust row, once the real API responds, shows the server-returned record.quantity in stock-cell-quantity

Through the real <App> at route `/` in a browser against the live DB, submitting a new quantity and actor in the row's adjust-row-<sku>-<location> form shows the new value in stock-cell-quantity before the response, with no page reload and no navigation (sku is a crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed key used in the create fill and the locators)

Through the real <App> at route `/` in a browser against the live DB, after an adjustment the row's stock-cell-quantity settles on the server-returned quantity, which matches the stored value on re-reading the stock list (unique crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed sku)

An accepted POST /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments returns 200 JSON whose record.quantity equals the newly stored quantity (the server-returned value the row's stock-cell-quantity settles on after the optimistic update)
POST /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments with a negative quantity on a uniquely-keyed seeded record returns 422 whose errors[] names the 'quantity' field
After a rejected negative-quantity adjustment, re-reading the record via the API shows the stored quantity is still the original Q
After a rejected negative-quantity adjustment, GET /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments returns an empty list (no audit entry written)
POST /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments with the quantity field omitted returns 422 whose errors[] names the 'quantity' field
POST /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments with quantity exactly 0 (boundary) returns 200 with record.quantity 0 and the stored quantity is 0

The adjustment service, called with its required injected session and a negative new quantity, rejects the write naming 'quantity' while the repository write functions (quantity update, adjustment insert) are patched and asserted never called
POST /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments with quantity < 0 returns 422 whose errors[] names 'quantity' and the stored quantity stays Q on the branch database
A direct INSERT into stock_adjustments with a negative quantity_before is rejected by the CHECK ck_stock_adjustments_quantities_non_negative

POST /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments with quantity < 0 returns 422 with errors[] naming 'quantity', and re-reading the record via the API returns the stored quantity Q (the server state the UI reverts stock-cell-quantity to and shows field-error-quantity from)
The inline adjust row, given a real-API 422 for a below-zero quantity, shows field-error-quantity naming quantity and reverts stock-cell-quantity to the stored Q
A rejected adjustment (negative quantity) leaves stock_records quantity and the stock_adjustments row count for that record unchanged on the branch database (delta-scoped to a per-run-unique sku)

The adjustment service, called with its required injected session and a blank or whitespace-only actor, rejects the write naming 'actor' while the repository write functions are patched and asserted never called
POST /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments with a blank actor returns 422 whose errors[] names 'actor'
A direct INSERT into stock_adjustments with an empty-string actor is rejected by the CHECK ck_stock_adjustments_actor_not_blank
A direct INSERT into stock_adjustments with a NULL actor is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint
The inline adjust row submitted with a blank actor shows field-error-actor naming actor, with stock-cell-quantity unchanged
A rejected adjustment (blank actor) leaves stock_records quantity and the stock_adjustments row count for that record unchanged on the branch database (delta-scoped to a per-run-unique sku)

Through the real <App> at route `/` in a browser against the live DB, submitting an adjustment with the actor left blank shows field-error-actor naming the actor field and leaves stock-cell-quantity at the stored value (unique crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed sku)
GET /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments returns every seeded adjustment with created_at, actor, quantity_before and quantity_after, ordered by created_at ascending then id
GET /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments responds with Content-Type application/json for a 200 and a 404 outcome, never text/html

With seeded stock_records rows (per-run-unique skus), downgrading to the stock_adjustments migration's own down_revision then upgrade head leaves every seeded stock_records row unchanged and recreates stock_adjustments with its columns, FK, checks and history index (explicit revision id, marked @pytest.mark.migration)
The S4 alembic upgrade() functions contain only additive operations (create_table, create_index, trigger/function creation), no drop_column, drop_table or alter type
A direct INSERT into stock_adjustments referencing a nonexistent stock_record_id is rejected by the foreign key
A direct INSERT into stock_adjustments omitting created_at stores a non-null DB-assigned timestamp from the server DEFAULT now()
A direct INSERT into stock_adjustments with a NULL quantity_before is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint

The adjustment-history panel for a record with seeded adjustments renders one history-entry-<n> per adjustment in time order, each with history-timestamp, history-actor, history-qty-before, history-qty-after
The adjustment-history panel for a record with no adjustments renders the history-empty empty-state instead of a blank table

Through the real <App> at route `/` in a browser against the live DB, opening history-toggle-<sku>-<location> after accepted adjustments shows the adjustment-history panel with one history-entry-<n> per adjustment (unique crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed sku)

Through the real <App> at route `/` in a browser against the live DB, each history-entry-<n> shows history-timestamp, history-actor, history-qty-before and history-qty-after in time order matching the adjustments entered (unique crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed sku)
After a refused DELETE of an adjustment, GET /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments still lists the entry with its original timestamp, actor and quantity_before/after
DELETE /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments/{adjustment_id} returns 405 with a JSON detail, the entry's timestamp, actor and quantities unchanged afterwards
PUT /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments/{adjustment_id} returns 405 with a JSON detail, the entry unchanged afterwards
PATCH /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments/{adjustment_id} returns 405 with a JSON detail, the entry unchanged afterwards
The 405 response of the adjustment-mutation path has Content-Type application/json, never text/html
A direct UPDATE of an existing stock_adjustments entry's created_at is refused by trigger trg_stock_adjustments_no_update, the row unchanged on re-read
The adjustment entry path advertises no mutation: an OPTIONS/Allow check on /api/stock-records/{id}/adjustments/{adjustment_id} lists none of PUT, PATCH, DELETE
